_warning: TEMPLATE ONLY. map_area, the dot sizes, the label offset and the circle colour bands are placeholders, not measured BGMI values. Run 'bgmi-scrim mapcalibrate <video> --out mymap.json --map ERANGEL' to set the map box, then check every number with 'mapcalibrate <video> --preview mymap.json --preview-png check.png'. Set _calibrated to true once the preview shows a green ring on every player dot, a magenta box over each name, and a red circle on both zone rings.

_calibration_notes.map_area: The playable square only: the map image, not the window or the panel around it. World size is taken from the map name (Erangel/Miramar/Rondo 8000 m, Vikendi 6000, Sanhok 4000, Livik/Karakin 2000, Nusa 1000) unless map.world_size_m overrides it.
_calibration_notes.dots: single_area is the pixel area of ONE player dot; a blob larger than cluster_ratio times that is treated as several players stacked. sat_min/val_min separate coloured dots from terrain. min_circularity throws away the zone rings and map lines.
_calibration_notes.label: dx/dy is the offset from the dot centre to the top-left of its name, w/h the size of that text box. player_min_score is how sure the roster match must be before a player name is attached; team tags survive a crowded label at a lower bar.
_calibration_notes.roster: team tag -> list of player names, exactly as the overlay writes them. Labels are matched against this list, so a missing name is never read.
_calibration_notes.circles: HSV bands for the safe circle and the blue circle. large_components_only keeps the ring and drops map text of the same colour; tol_px should be about the ring's thickness in pixels.
_calibration_notes.tracking: max_speed_mps gates how far a dot may move between samples; min_identity_conf is the share of votes a team needs before a track is named at all.
